tasks.subject: Task 1: coverage and thresholds in just test-worker
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `just test-worker` writes worker.lcov and fails on a coverage regression, keeping its skip and failure-propagation behaviour.

**Verify:** just test-worker && just check-all

```json:metadata
{"files": ["justfile", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "just test-worker && just check-all", "acceptanceCriteria": ["worker.lcov written with the right SF path", "readable output preserved", "raised threshold fails, lowered passes", "failing test still exits non-zero", "node-absent still skips with exit 0", "both OS variants match", "worker.lcov gitignored"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: the CI job and the Codecov upload
tasks.description:
**Goal:** CI runs the worker tests once, they block releases, and coverage reaches Codecov under flags: worker.

**Verify:** workflow parses; just check-all

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/test.yml"], "verifyCommand": "just check-all", "acceptanceCriteria": ["test-worker job on ubuntu with Node 24", "artifact name does not match *.coverage", "coverage-combine needs it, downloads it, uploads with flags: worker", "python upload gains flags: python", "every action SHA-pinned", "workflow parses / actionlint clean"]}
```
